scope: Dependency audit and controlled updates — no blind upgrades.
decision: No bulk dependency upgrades. Security-relevant dependency changes are isolated by stage and must carry package/lockfile diff review plus regression evidence before merge.

controlledFollowups.subject: passport-discord
controlledFollowups.rule: Prove runtime reachability/absence first; remove or migrate only with OAuth/session regression coverage.

controlledFollowups.subject: inflight/glob transitive chain
controlledFollowups.rule: Trace exact dependency ancestry and runtime/dev relevance before any parent-package update.

controlledFollowups.subject: dashboard bundle
controlledFollowups.rule: Measure build chunks before targeted code splitting; no speculative dependency churn.

contracts.lockfile: package-lock.json remains mandatory and reviewed with every dependency mutation
contracts.noBlind: No bulk/major upgrade without stage-scoped coupling analysis and regression tests
contracts.securityGate: npm audit --audit-level=high is blocking after Stage 45 hardening
contracts.sbomGate: CycloneDX SBOM generation is fail-closed after Stage 45 hardening
contracts.shaRule: Any package.json/package-lock/test/config change resets the PR gate to 0/2

verification.passA: Manifest/lockfile/source-of-truth and security-gate contracts crosschecked on current main.
verification.passB: Follow-up work split by coupling boundary so passport OAuth, transitive legacy packages, and UI bundle work cannot be conflated into a blind update wave.
